Name: Cutaway
Author: Cutaway
Description: Run Cutaway from your Stream Deck: scenes and sources with live pictures and tally colours, take and cut, transitions, record, go live, markers, graphics, audio inputs (with Stream Deck+ dials), auto-switching, captions, media players, sound pads, Syrinscape, talkback, instant clips, timers, the rundown, remote guests, fade to black, instant replay, macros, PTZ cameras, the teleprompter, viewer comments and any Cutaway command.

Actions.Name: Scene
Actions.Tooltip: Take a scene. Shows its live picture: red on air, green in preview.

Actions.Name: Source
Actions.Tooltip: A source full screen, with its live picture and tally.

Actions.Name: Take / Cut
Actions.Tooltip: Preview to program, with the transition or instantly.

Actions.Name: Transition
Actions.Tooltip: Choose the transition: cut, mix, wipe, push, dip or stinger.

Actions.Name: Record
Actions.Tooltip: Start recording; hold to stop.

Actions.Name: Go Live
Actions.Tooltip: Hold to go live; hold to end the stream.

Actions.Name: Marker
Actions.Tooltip: Drop a marker in the recording.

Actions.Name: Graphic
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide a logo, title or lower third.

Actions.Name: Audio Input
Actions.Tooltip: Turn an input on or off, with a level meter. On a Stream Deck+ dial: turn for level, press for on/off.

Actions.Name: Auto Switching
Actions.Tooltip: Turn automatic switching (follows who's talking) on or off.

Actions.Name: Captions
Actions.Tooltip: Turn live captions on or off.

Actions.Name: Media Player
Actions.Tooltip: Play, pause, next or restart a media player source.

Actions.Name: Sound Pad
Actions.Tooltip: Play a sound pad; lit with its progress while it plays.

Actions.Name: Syrinscape
Actions.Tooltip: Start a Syrinscape mood or sound set up in Cutaway.

Actions.Name: Talkback
Actions.Tooltip: Your mic in the presenters' ears while held.

Actions.Name: Clip
Actions.Tooltip: Save the last few seconds of the recording as a clip.

Actions.Name: Timer
Actions.Tooltip: Start, pause or reset a countdown or stopwatch; shows its time.

Actions.Name: Rundown
Actions.Tooltip: Next segment, with the time left in this one.

Actions.Name: Guest
Actions.Tooltip: A remote guest: whether they're on, and a press shows them.

Actions.Name: Fade to Black
Actions.Tooltip: Fade the program (picture and sound) to black, and back up; lit while black.

Actions.Name: Instant Replay
Actions.Tooltip: Play the last few seconds again (in slow motion if you like) while recording; press again to stop.

Actions.Name: Macro
Actions.Tooltip: Run one of Cutaway's macros: several commands with one press.

Actions.Name: PTZ Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Recall a PTZ preset, go home, or move while held (real or virtual PTZ cameras).

Actions.Name: Teleprompter
Actions.Tooltip: Roll or pause the script, change speed, or jump back and forward.

Actions.Name: Viewer Comment
Actions.Tooltip: Show the next comment from the live chat on screen, or hide it.

Actions.Name: Command
Actions.Tooltip: Any Cutaway command, e.g. preview:2, graphic:Logo:on, gain:Mic:-6.
